info.name: BepInExPack Valheim
info.author: denikson
info.description: BepInEx pack for Valheim. Preconfigured with the correct entry point for mods and preferred defaults for the community.

info.name: Jotunn
info.author: ValheimModding
info.description: Jötunn (/ˈjɔːtʊn/, 'giant'), the Valheim Library was created with the goal of making the lives of mod developers easier. It enables you to create mods for Valheim using an abstracted API so you can focus on the actual content creation.

info.name: PlantEverything
info.author: Advize
info.description: Allows your cultivator to plant berry bushes, thistle, dandelions, mushrooms, previously unavailable tree types, and other decorative flora. Includes many other miscellaneous features (see description). Highly configurable with localization support.

info.name: JsonDotNET
info.author: ValheimModding
info.description: Shared version 13.0.3 of Json.NET from Newtonsoft, net45 package for use in Valheim mods. Maintained by the ValheimModding team.

info.name: EpicLoot
info.author: RandyKnapp
info.description: Adds loot drops, magic items, and enchanting to Valheim.

info.name: Warfare
info.author: Therzie
info.description: Fills the weapon and shields gap in vanilla Valheim and with MANY new weapons and unique extras!

info.name: Server devcommands
info.author: JereKuusela
info.description: Enables devcommands and utilities for server admins.

info.name: YamlDotNet
info.author: ValheimModding
info.description: Shared version 16.3.0 of YamlDotNet from Antoine Aubry and contributors, net47 package for use in Valheim mods. Maintained by the ValheimModding team.

info.name: ConditionalConfigSync
info.author: shudnal
info.description: Shared config synchronization and server policy library for Valheim mods. Installed as a dependency and compatible with Jotunn and ServerSync.

info.name: ExtraSlots
info.author: shudnal
info.description: More inventory slots dedicated for equipment, food, ammo and misc items. Extra utility slots. Quick slots. Custom slots API. Player inventory resize. Gamepad friendly. Slot obtaining progression.

info.name: PlantEasily
info.author: Advize
info.description: Allows you to plant evenly spaced crops, either one at a time or in any amount of rows and columns, with grid snapping features and invalid crop placement prevention. Harvest in bulk and optionally auto replant crops. Configurable and supports gamepad.

info.name: AdventureBackpacks
info.author: Vapok
info.description: A Valheim Mod to add a catalogue of Adventuring Backpacks to the Game. These packs will grow and become more useful as the game progresses.

info.name: OdinArchitect
info.author: OdinPlus
info.description: Odin Architect is a mod that will allow you to build more with more structures and on a larger scale. You will find here not only larger counterparts of basic buildings but also completely new ones

info.name: BetterArchery
info.author: ishid4
info.description: Adds many features and changes to bow gameplay.

info.name: Monstrum
info.author: Therzie
info.description: Adds new monsters and mini-bosses to fight and tame for original Valheim up till Mistlands.

info.name: Armory
info.author: Therzie
info.description: Adds the Armory forge that offers new variants of original armors that upgrade to the next biome.

info.name: OdinHorse
info.author: OdinPlus
info.description: Horse mount and new items! You can tame it, You can ride it, You can attach the Horse Cart, You can breed it, Add armor to your horse!

info.name: MultiUserChest
info.author: MSchmoecker
info.description: Allows multiple players to interact with the same chest at the same time

info.name: Seasonality
info.author: RustyMods
info.description: Dynamic seasons by altering textures and colors, providing an immersive environmental experience that changes with time.

info.name: OdinsKingdom
info.author: OdinPlus
info.description: A custom piece mod by the OdinPlus team, this mod adds several castle construction pieces with a custom build tool.

info.name: MagicPlugin
info.author: blacks7ar
info.description: Adds early-game till end-game magic weapons (elemental and summoning totems) and armor sets, accessories with their own inventory slot, eitr foods and a battle mount.

info.name: Wizardry
info.author: Therzie
info.description: Fills the magical gap in vanilla Valheim with MANY unique extras!

info.name: ValheimArmory
info.author: MidnightMods
info.description: ValheimArmory aims to create a more diverse selection of weapons to make all playstyles feel fully supported at each level.

info.name: SouthsilArmor
info.author: southsil
info.description: Adds over 30 entirely new armor sets, spread across all biomes!

info.name: Blacksmiths tools
info.author: GoldenJude
info.description: Tool for hiding parts of the player model when equipping wearables, also a fix for incorrectly deforming skinned meshes on custom items.

info.name: Judes Equipment
info.author: GoldenJude
info.description: Adds 9 new armor sets and 2 backpacks for increasing carry weight

info.name: WieldEquipmentWhileSwimming
info.author: blacks7ar
info.description: A simple mod that lets you wield your equipments while swimming/diving or in water (Configurable).

info.name: VikingsDoSwim
info.author: blacks7ar
info.description: A simple mod that lets you configure Max Swim Speed at max swim skill level. Scales your swim speed, stamina regen and stamina consumption to your swim skill level. Adds a new diving mechanic that lets you swim underwater.

info.name: MissingPieces
info.author: BentoG
info.description: A fix for what impedes your building fix.

info.name: SearsCatalog
info.author: ComfyMods
info.description: Resize and reposition the build panel in-game.

info.name: PotionPlus
info.author: OdinPlus
info.description: Adds several potions to the game, now with improved skills, new potions, new config options, and server sync!!

info.name: ValheimRAFT
info.author: zolantris
info.description: ValheimRAFT - supports valheim 1.0.0 Deep North. A vehicles mod for valheim. Build a ship, build a land vehicle. Explore valheim!

info.name: SeaAnimals
info.author: Marlthon
info.description: Give life to Valheim’s oceans with dangerous creatures, rideable marine beasts, and true ocean exploration. The sea is no longer empty.

info.name: OdinShip
info.author: Marlthon
info.description: Add to your game the most beautiful and functional boats, in all there are 7 boats in the cargo and war categories.

info.name: More World Locations AIO
info.author: warpalicious
info.description: Adds 190 new POI locations including dungeons, traders, ports and much more to enhance Valheim's world exploration.

info.name: Cats
info.author: Marlthon
info.description: Bring cuteness, comfort, and a touch of purrfection to the harsh lands of Valheim!

info.name: OdinTrainingPlace
info.author: OdinPlus
info.description: Training Place is just simple mod for additional pieces thanks to which you can level up Your skills faster or just use them as decoration of your village. If you're building lover this is definitely another mod for you.

info.name: Valharvest
info.author: Frenvius
info.description: Expands Valheim's farming and cooking with new crops (rice, tomatoes, pumpkins, apples and more), lox milking, and custom cooking stations with dozens of recipes.

info.name: ValheimCuisine
info.author: Xutz
info.description: Adds more than 300 food recipes inspired on cultural nordic delicacies, with norse mythology references to fit the game.

info.name: Spearfishing
info.author: Korppis
info.description: Catch fish with projectile weapons such as spear, harpoon and bow.

info.name: SimpleElevators
info.author: blacks7ar
info.description: A mod that adds a total of 41 small and large elevators, horizontal, vertical and diagonal platforms.

info.name: balrond constructions
info.author: Balrond
info.description: A growing set of over 300 construction pieces of both vanilla types and new

info.name: OdinsFoodBarrels
info.author: OdinPlus
info.description: ModWish from OdinPlus Community - buildable dynamic storage containers for seeds, fruits, and vegetables!

info.name: More Vanilla Build Prefabs
info.author: Searica
info.description: Adds almost everything in the vanilla game to the hammer for building in survival mode. Every piece can be customized and enabled/disabled. Comes with a default configuration for ease of use. Uses Jotunn to sync configs if installed on server.

info.name: VNEI
info.author: MSchmoecker
info.description: Valheim Not Enough Items. Displays all items and recipes inside a UI

info.name: Upgrade World
info.author: JereKuusela
info.description: A tool which can add new content to already explored areas.

info.name: BoneAppetit
info.author: AWLGaming
info.description: BoneAppetit foods and cooking stations, maintained for Valheim by AWL Gaming.

info.name: LongshipUpgrades
info.author: shudnal
info.description: Upgrade your vanilla Longship piece by piece with lantern, changeable sails, tent, shields, extended storage and more.
